          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '(?s).*\S.*'

          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string

      properties:
        type:

          maximum: 600

          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true

          title: Timestamp

          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'

          items:

        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors

      type: object
      properties:
        message:

          type: string
